t: A hybrid assessment of clinical mobility test items for evaluating individuals with mild traumatic brain injury - PMC
s: The Functional Gait Assessment (FGA) and High Level Mobility Assessment Tool (HiMAT) are clinical batteries used to assess people with mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI).
